quests.title: Let's Make A Flower Garland!

dialogue.t: Huh? Did you see that thing I wrote? Wow, that worked better than I thought...
So did you already finish gathering three Silk Flowers?
These Silk Flowers should be just the right amount. My garland will be done in no time now!
Thank you. Here, these are for you.
I know Daddy will just love this pretty garland.

quests.description: Liyue Harbor’s Changchang needs three Silk Flowers.
